context.why: Third dispatch of FS-031. US1-US3 are accepted: docker/Dockerfile, docker/entrypoint.sh (with start steps), docker/portal.Dockerfile, docker/smoke-test.sh (13 checks, copies its start step in with docker cp), docker-compose.yml on the development image, docs. Build US5 first (T014-T016): .github/workflows/test-suite.yml runs the suite inside the development image built from the branch (plan P5); .github/workflows/image.yml builds both targets and the demo portal and runs docker/smoke-test.sh with PostGIS and Redis service containers on the runner (plan P6 steps 1-3); local evidence that a broken image fails. Then US4 (T017-T018): docker/publish.sh and image.yml step 4 (plan P6), proven against a local registry; guide section on image versions.
prior_decisions: D1: the images contain no FairDM and no portal code.
D3: a production portal installs its dependencies on the development image and runs on the runtime image.
D4: the start sequence is migrate --noinput, collectstatic --noinput, compress, then gunicorn. Not django-setup-tools.
D6: no image exists for any release yet; portal.Dockerfile's FAIRDM_VERSION ARG has no default.
D8: delete COMPRESS_ENABLED = True and COMPRESS_OFFLINE = False from config/settings.py (lines 9-10).
D9 watch items: name every env var passed to docker run; smoke-test requests send X-Forwarded-Proto: https because production redirects to HTTPS (fairdm/conf/settings/security.py:36).
D11: remove django-compressor and django-libsass; start sequence is migrate, collectstatic, the portal's steps, gunicorn. Leave demo/static/scss/ and docs/portal-development/theme*.md untouched.
D11 is final: there is no compress step. Start steps run after collectstatic and before gunicorn.

D6: v0.1.0 gets no images. D7: publish.sh pushes only the missing tags of <version> and <version>-dev, never moves an existing one; only a not-found answer from `docker buildx imagetools inspect` counts as absent. D9: name every env var passed to docker run. D12: the smoke test copies its start step in with docker cp. On a GitHub runner, SMOKE_NETWORK defaults to host and the service containers are on localhost.
constitution: Article I: every change follows docs/contributing/standards/testing.md: what gets a test and what does not, test-first, structure and fixtures. Tests are grouped into Test<Subject> classes. A test whose subject is not a Python module is exempt from mirroring only when declared in [tool.forge.conformance] non-mirror-paths in pyproject.toml; add "tests/test_docker/" there (T001). Wording and appearance get no tests.
Article II: start with the simplest design that satisfies the spec. Article III: no wrapper layers or future-proofing indirection without a present second use.
Article VI: public changes ship their docs in the same pull request. Every documented example must work against the branch. Documentation describes behaviour in testable terms.
environment: Docker: use docker.exe (Docker Desktop on Windows, reachable from this WSL shell). The plain docker CLI gets permission denied on the socket. docker.exe accepts WSL paths for build contexts and bind mounts under /home.

Docker Desktop does not give containers the host's network like a Linux CI runner does. Make docker/smoke-test.sh work in both places: in CI it will run with a PostGIS service container on the runner's localhost (US5 wires that); locally, start postgis/postgis:17-3.5 on a user-defined docker network and run the portal container on the same network. Have the script take the database host and the network from environment variables with CI-suitable defaults, and document the local invocation in a comment at the top of the script.

Python tests: run with `uv run pytest -n0 tests/test_docker/` for your own tests. The full suite needs GDAL and the local PostGIS: export GDAL_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/sam/.local/opt/micromamba/root/envs/gis/lib/libgdal.so GEOS_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/sam/.local/opt/micromamba/root/envs/gis/lib/libgeos_c.so (the local PostGIS is already running on port 5432, socket in /tmp). The full verify at your section 5 is: `/home/sam/.openclaw/workspaces/forge/engineering-org/kit/forge verify --repo /home/sam/projects/worktrees/fairdm-031-base-image --base origin/main` with those two variables exported.

Entrypoint tests (T001, T002): run docker/entrypoint.sh with subprocess under /bin/sh, with PATH starting with a tmp_path directory of stand-in python, gunicorn and celery scripts that append their argv to a log file and exit with a status the test controls. No Docker in the Python tests.

Workflows cannot run locally. Write them carefully: keep the test job's `name:` exactly `Test Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}, Django ${{ matrix.django-version }}` and the caller job id `call-tests` in tests.yml, so the required check `call-tests / Test Python 3.13, Django 5.2` keeps its name. Validate syntax with `uvx --from check-jsonschema check-jsonschema --builtin-schema vendor.github-workflows <file>` and `uvx actionlint` if available (if actionlint cannot be installed, say so). The orchestrator pushes and reads the CI result.

Pin actions to major versions already used in the repo where they exist (actions/checkout@v7, codecov/codecov-action@v7); for docker/setup-buildx-action, docker/build-push-action and docker/login-action use their current major tags, and actions/cache likewise.

T016: on a throwaway local branch you delete afterwards (never committed to 031-base-image), remove gdal-bin from docker/Dockerfile, rebuild, and show both the smoke test and `pytest tests/test_smoke.py` inside the development image fail. Paste commands and the failing lines into T016's evidence.

T017: run `registry:2` with docker.exe on localhost:5000 and prove: a first run of docker/publish.sh pushes both tags; a second leaves both digests unchanged; with only <version> present it pushes only <version>-dev; with the registry stopped it exits non-zero having pushed nothing. publish.sh takes the version and the repository (default ghcr.io/fair-dm/fairdm) and the local image names to publish from; read plan P6 for the contract.

verified_base.note: independently re-verified by the orchestrator at US2/US3 acceptance

acceptance: T014: test-suite.yml builds the development target (cached) and runs uv sync, the Django pin check and pytest with coverage inside it against the PostGIS service; the GDAL install, setup-uv and host sync steps are gone; required check name unchanged; Codecov step still uploads coverage.xml.

T015: image.yml with job `Image`, triggers pull_request, push to main, release published, workflow_dispatch; concurrency group image-${{ github.ref }} without cancel-in-progress; builds both targets and the demo, runs smoke-test.sh; publishes nothing yet.
T017: publish.sh plus image.yml step 4 (only on refs/tags/v*, login with GITHUB_TOKEN, packages: write), linux/amd64 only; local-registry evidence as described.

T018: guide states image tags equal the FairDM release without its v, `-dev` for the development image, no latest, a portal pinned to a commit between releases uses the images of the last release before that commit while that commit has not changed FairDM's system requirements, and images appear only when the release is created with RELEASE_TOKEN.
